title: Run a local plan through an authorized graph executor
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Fangore ships a host app with a produce → repair → consume plan. After linkage succeeds, the library must walk ready steps, refuse execution without an execute grant, retry transient failures, escalate when retries are exhausted, emit start and end telemetry, and finish the downstream consume step only after upstream success. Checkpointed plans from `fangore_local_plan_resume` stay durable; preflight failures are covered by `fangore_graph_linkage_preflight`. See inspiration requirements for authorized graph execution[^insp-executor].
implementation:
`GraphExecutor` in `mechaharness.graph_executor` is a pyiv injectable: constructor takes `EventLog`, `AccessControl`, `GraphNodeRunnerRegistry`, `GraphFailurePolicy`, `GraphEscalation`, and `LinkageResolver`. Hosts register node runners by open `kind` string via `MechaHarnessConfig.get_node_runner_registry()`, override failure/escalation/linkage hooks, and grant `core:graph.execute` / `core:graph.escalate`. The executor emits `core:graph_start` / `core:graph_end` plus per-node events. `CliInstrumentor` verb `graph_executor_run` exercises the path.

Acceptance walks the registered CLI verb (TestHarnessCliConfig promotes remaining story probes when no src product verb exists yet).
validation: Harness `user_story` walks the promoted product/test verb (no `probe:` wrapper); hard expects on declared observation keys.
